title: Certain output has probability one
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. If every choice word of length exactly $t$ produces the same output $v$, then the probability of outputting $v$ after $t$ choices is $1$.
